A stylish seating option that complements both modern and traditional décor.

6ft Farm Table – Brown
products.description: Add rustic charm and natural elegance to your event with our 6ft Farm Table in brown. Crafted with a rich wooden finish and sturdy trestle-style legs, this table delivers a warm, inviting look perfect for weddings, beach receptions, private dinners, and family-style dining. Its spacious surface comfortably seats 6–8 guests and pairs beautifully with a wide range of chairs, décor styles, and tablescapes from boho and vintage to modern rustic.Durable, stylish, and versatile, this farm table brings authentic character to any setting.

products.name: 36″ Banquet Cocktail Table
products.description: The 36″ Banquet Cocktail Table is a stylish and functional addition to any event layout. Designed with a sleek metal pedestal base and a clean round tabletop, it’s perfect for cocktail hours, standing receptions, mixers, beach events, and intimate gatherings. The height makes it ideal for guests to stand comfortably, mingle, and place drinks or light bites. Its simple, modern look blends effortlessly with any décor theme, indoors or outdoors.

products.name: 36″ Banquet Table
products.description: Our 36″ Banquet Table is a versatile event essential, perfect for both small and large gatherings. With its sturdy metal base and clean round tabletop, it works well for cocktail setups, guest seating, vendor stations, coffee displays, or intimate dining arrangements. Its compact size makes it easy to place throughout any event layout while maintaining a neat, functional look. Ideal for weddings, corporate functions, pop-up events, and private parties.

products.name: Luxury Serpentine Table – White
products.description: Elevate your event layout with our Luxury Serpentine Table in white. Designed with a smooth curved shape and elegant turned legs, this table brings a sophisticated, high-end look to weddings, corporate receptions, and upscale celebrations. Its modular serpentine design allows you to create creative configurations S-shapes, semi-circles, waves, or striking centrepieces. Perfect for dessert displays, bars, buffets, sign-in tables, or statement décor setups. Stylish, versatile, and premium in finish, it transforms any event space.

products.name: Wooden Cake Table
products.description: Showcase your cake or dessert display in timeless style with our Wooden Cake Table. Crafted with a beautifully carved pedestal base and a rich wooden finish, this table adds warmth and elegance to any event. Its sturdy design makes it perfect for wedding cakes, dessert spreads, welcome displays, or statement décor pieces. Whether used indoors or on the beach, it brings a rustic yet refined look to your setup.

products.name: Wooden Cocktail Table
products.description: Bring natural warmth and modern design to your event with our Wooden Cocktail Table. Featuring a round wooden top and a striking open-slat pedestal base, this table adds a stylish, contemporary touch to any space. Perfect for cocktail hours, beach events, receptions, lounges, and intimate gatherings, it offers a comfortable standing height for guests to mingle, enjoy drinks, and socialize. Its elegant craftsmanship makes it suitable for both rustic and upscale décor themes.

products.name: Gold Reef Glass
products.description: Add a touch of luxury to your table setting with our Gold Reef Glass Charger Plate. Featuring a beautifully textured reef-inspired rim and a radiant gold finish, this charger instantly elevates any tablescape. Perfect for weddings, banquets, corporate dinners, and upscale celebrations, it pairs effortlessly with a wide range of dinnerware and décor styles. Elegant and eye-catching, it enhances both classic and modern event themes.

Comfortable, versatile, and elegant this ottoman elevates any space while offering functional seating for guests.

products.name: Single Seater Armchair

Perfect for weddings, private events, lounges, and corporate functions, it blends effortlessly with any décor style. Ideal as a standalone piece or paired with other lounge furniture to create a cohesive seating area.

products.name: Two-Seater Sofa

Pair it with our single seaters, ottomans, or coffee tables to build a cohesive lounge area.
